description:
Address lookup by nummeraanduiding ID

Returns full BAG address data for a given BAG nummeraanduiding ID.
The nummeraanduiding ID is a 16-digit identifier from the BAG register.

Data is sourced from the PDOK BAG open API (Landelijke Voorziening BAG).

Results are cached for 24 hours. The upstream timeout is 8 seconds;
if PDOK is unavailable the endpoint returns HTTP 503.

Source: [PDOK BAG](https://api.pdok.nl/lv/bag/open-api/v1_5)

Cost: 1 credit(s) per call. An API key is required via the X-Api-Key header (or Authorization: Bearer <key>); a per-call wallet payment via x402 is also accepted.
name: kadaster.bag.id
